newsitem.title: USA: Excel Corp reducing hours at six beef plants.
newsitem.headline: Excel Corp reducing hours at six beef plants.

text.p: Excel Corp, a division of Cargill Inc, said it has begun reducing hours of operation at its six beef plants this week because of tight cattle supplies and negative packer margins.
The company said it was unclear when it would resume regular hours at the plants and it did not specify the extent to which hours had been reduced.
The affected plants are in Dodge City, Kansas; Plainview and Friona, Texas; Fort Morgan and Sterling, Colorado; and Schuyler, Nebraska.
IBP Inc officials were unable to comment on whether operating hours had been reduced at their plants, and ConAgra Inc officials were unavailable for comment.
